author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: We need to prepare the I-526E petition filing strategy for Xiulan Liu's EB-5 investor visa application (M-2024-032). This is a regional center investment case and the source-of-funds documentation is critical — dedicate a section to the source-of-funds tracing methodology. Pull the matter file for M-2024-032 to review all case details, including the investment in the Oakland Innovation Hub project — name that project in the memo's I-526E analysis — and the $800K investment amount. Check our document vault for any source-of-funds documentation, economic analysis reports, or business plans already assembled. Search for recent federal court and AAO decisions on EB-5 investor visa petitions, focusing on source-of-funds challenges, TEA (Targeted Employment Area) designation disputes, and job creation methodology under the regional center program. I need rulings that address the evidentiary standard for tracing investment capital from foreign business proceeds. Read the key opinions carefully. Also research the current USCIS processing times and any policy guidance on the reformed EB-5 program under the RIA (EB-5 Reform and Integrity Act of 2022). Look for cases discussing the new integrity measures and their impact on regional center petitions. Compile a filing strategy memo covering: (1) I-526E petition requirements and current standards, (2) source-of-funds documentation best practices from case law, (3) analysis of our evidence package, and (4) potential RFE issues to preemptively address. Draft the completed work product using the legal drafting tools and save it to the matter file. Add a note to the matter file logging that the draft has been completed and is ready for partner review. Reference the IOE petition number and discuss the regional center job creation methodology. The memo should incorporate the RIMS II job creation figure of 14.2 jobs per investor from the economic analysis and note the Shenzhen TechVision sale to Huawei Cloud Services as the primary capital source. Transmit the filing strategy memo to eb5-team@zhangkwon.com by email with subject 'EB-5 Filing Strategy - Liu / M-2024-032' once the draft is saved, so the EB-5 team can begin assembling the petition package. Work through every step with actual tool use -- deliver output, not instructions.
